description: List another Spotify user's public playlists (paginated). Removed by Spotify's February 2026 Web API changes — unavailable for newer app registrations. Output is capped by max_results (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS).

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

user_id.description: Spotify user ID, spotify:user: URI, or open.spotify.com/user URL

name: get_user_playlists_by_id
